=== bin/semver-bump ===
#!/bin/bash
# usage: semver-bump VERSION major|minor|patch
IFS=. read -r major minor patch <<< "$1"
case "$2" in
  major) echo "$((major + 1)).0.0" ;;
  minor) echo "$major.$((minor + 1)).$patch" ;;
  patch) echo "$major.$minor.$((patch + 1))" ;;
  *) echo "semver-bump: unknown part '$2'" >&2; exit 2 ;;
esac

#!/bin/bash
# Test runner: runs every tests/test_*.sh, writes build/test-report.txt.
cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." || exit 2
mkdir -p build
pass=0; fail=0; total=0
for t in tests/test_*.sh; do
  name=$(basename "$t" .sh)
  total=$((total + 1))
  if bash "$t" > "build/$name.log" 2>&1; then
    pass=$((pass + 1)); echo "ok   $name"
  else
    fail=$((fail + 1)); echo "FAIL $name"; sed 's/^/    /' "build/$name.log"
  fi
done
if [ "$fail" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "PASS $pass/$total" | tee build/test-report.txt
else
  echo "FAIL $fail/$total" | tee build/test-report.txt
  exit 1
fi
